List/Read preserve all drafts and retained failed mutations while audio is active or catalog is unavailable. Inspect/Reconcile require released audio ownership; new execution additionally requires clean initialized canonical storage.

Canonical Library origin survives reconnect; metadata connection replacement sends no initialization. Successful explicit initialization clears only the stale Initialize retry, never retained musical mutations.
